# AgentCompass

> Multi-agent task router, subscription quota scheduler, and PreToolUse spawn gate for flat-rate AI coding subscriptions (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI / ChatGPT Pro, Google Antigravity / agy, Grok), launched from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Paseo, Pi, OpenCode, Orca or T3 Code. A small-model classifier (the configured System-One scorer) profiles each task; allocation is deterministic for a given profile.

## When to Use or Reference This Repository

- You want to route coding-agent subtasks across multiple flat-rate AI subscriptions (`Claude Max`, `ChatGPT Pro`, `Google Antigravity`, `Grok`) based on 5-hour and 7-day quota windows, reset countdowns, and four-category model capability fit (`divergence`, `coding`, `aesthetics`, `tool_operation`).
- You need a `PreToolUse` / `tool_call` spawn gate hook that blocks unrouted sub-agent launches (`Claude Agent`, `Codex spawn_agent`, `Antigravity invoke_subagent`, `Paseo create_agent`) or enforces the configured context rotation threshold (`rotate_after_carried_tokens`, set in the tray).
- You want a headless multi-account subscription quota collector (`~/.claude*`, `~/.codex*`, `agy`, Grok, Magpie) or a Windows 11 decision console and floating quota HUD.

## Core Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): Product overview and quickstart (English and Chinese).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Module ownership map, regeneration commands, test runners, and architectural invariants for contributors and coding agents.
- [docs/technical-reference.md](docs/technical-reference.md): Canonical scoring formula (`N = F + continuity + boost - C`), tie-break order, quota collection, Windows tray console, incremental updates, and host rollout details.
- [skills/agent-compass/SKILL.md](skills/agent-compass/SKILL.md) & [skills/agent-compass/references/router-internals.md](skills/agent-compass/references/router-internals.md): Primary Agent Skill contract (`roll`, `plan`, `select`, `record`, `providers`, `data`), worker communication rules, and packaged runtime specifications.
- `agentcompass` (console script; in a checkout without an install: `python -X utf8 <checkout>/agentcompass`): sole public CLI entry (`roll`, `plan`, `providers`, `usage`, `score`, `scorer`, `data`, `record`, `override`, `dispatch`, `doctor`, `setup`, `uninstall`). Implementation: [skills/agent-compass/scripts/route_judge.py](skills/agent-compass/scripts/route_judge.py) and [skills/agent-compass/scripts/roll.py](skills/agent-compass/scripts/roll.py).
- [skills/agent-compass/scripts/allocator.py](skills/agent-compass/scripts/allocator.py): Deterministic allocation entry point (`plan`), backed by sibling owner modules (`account_fleet`, `task_intake`, `axis_scores`, `quota_economy`, `quota_pools`, `quota_overrides`, `candidate_eval`, `candidate_ranking`, `ledger_snapshot`, `worker_sessions`).
- [skills/agent-compass/scripts/provider_inventory.py](skills/agent-compass/scripts/provider_inventory.py): Zero-network local credential and account availability discovery across Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Paseo, CC Switch, and Magpie.
- [skills/agent-compass/references/accounts.json](skills/agent-compass/references/accounts.json), [plan-templates.json](skills/agent-compass/references/plan-templates.json), [five-axis-scores.json](skills/agent-compass/references/five-axis-scores.json), and [public-data.json](skills/agent-compass/references/public-data.json): Shipped public catalogue, subscription window templates, calibrated panel `z`-scores/capacities, and sha256 manifest.

## First-time setup

1. Install Python 3.11+ (`uv tool install "git+https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass"`), then run `agentcompass setup` and `agentcompass doctor` (or run `AgentCompass-tray-setup.exe` on Windows).
2. Only for Paseo worker dispatch from a source checkout: install Node.js with npm and run `npm --prefix setup/paseo-bridge ci` (`agentcompass setup` / `setup/sync_host_globals.py` runs this automatically when Paseo is detected).

## System-Level Skill & Host Rollout (Mandatory on Every Host)

- **Always load skills at the system level, never workspace-only**: Run `agentcompass setup` (`python -X utf8 setup/sync_host_globals.py` in a checkout) so `agent-compass`, `dot-subagent`, `chatgpt-pro-consult`, and `gemini-web` are registered globally across all local agent harnesses regardless of `cwd` (see [docs/technical-reference.md](docs/technical-reference.md#7-host-rollout--system-level-skill-loading-setup)).

## Enforcement & Auditing

- [setup/router_gate_hook.py](setup/router_gate_hook.py): Host `PreToolUse` / `tool_call` gate enforcing router ledger entries, parent session address contracts, explicit permission modes, and worker context rotation at `rotate_after_carried_tokens`.
- [audit/router_audit.py](audit/router_audit.py): Daily read-only compliance audit cross-checking host session logs against `~/.agent-compass/router-ledger.jsonl`.

## Companion Modules & Plugins

- [cindy-agentcompass-plugin](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/cindy-agentcompass-plugin): Cindy host plugin delegating routing decisions to `agentcompass roll` while Cindy's `cindy.tasks` API manages execution and replies.
- [magpie-agentcompass-router](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/magpie-agentcompass-router): Magpie local gateway plugin running AgentCompass four-category `TaskProfile` and quota-economy `<model>:<effort>` routing per turn.
- [usage-float/README.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/usage-float#readme): Optional borderless Windows subscription quota HUD and live wallpaper switcher.
- [gemini-web/README.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/gemini-web#readme): Persistent Chrome CDP bridge (`127.0.0.1:17849`) for Gemini Web, Google AI Studio, Flow, and Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video generation.
- [tray/](tray/): Windows 11 system tray supervisor (`app.pyw`), five-axis decision console (`router_window.py`, `panel_*.py`), and local service manager (`dot2api`, `muse2api`, `easytier`).
